source_sdm_execution_contract.reuse_rule: reuse production_sdm_execution unchanged except outer-fold and candidate-generation steps are not rerun; read the already frozen training_occurrences.csv and candidate_pool_pre_outcome.csv from the primary confirmation artifact

decision.candidate_universe: exact frozen Practical Core candidate_pool_pre_outcome rows
decision.tie_break: descending rounded sdm_suitability then stable candidate_id
decision.failure_rule: fit/extraction/fewer-than-five-finite-candidate failure scores zero for fitted_sdm_top_k in the all-declared secondary estimand; evaluable-only estimand is also reported
decision.decision_freeze: write SDM audit and selected candidate IDs before reading held_out_occurrences.csv

reporting.primary_role: secondary decision-positioning analysis only; never changes or gates the Practical Core-vs-GRTS primary result
sdm_evaluable_outputs: same paired recall metrics restricted to folds with status sdm_ok
set_difference_outputs: Top-5 Jaccard overlap per SDM-evaluable fold
reporting.claim_rule: report equivalence, advantage, or disadvantage as observed; use set overlap to demonstrate decision differentiation only when supported

leakage_guardrail: held-out coordinates and outcomes are unavailable to SDM fitting, candidate environment extraction, suitability scoring, and Top-5 selection; they are read only after the SDM decision artifact is frozen
